newsitem.title: USA: Enron's 12 pct shr net rise achieves goals.
newsitem.headline: Enron's 12 pct shr net rise achieves goals.

text.p: Enron Corp Tuesday reported a 12 percent increase in 1996 earnings per share, to $2.31 per share from $2.07 in 1995 saying the company achieved its earnings and operational goals.
Fourth quarter earnings per share were unchanged at $0.52 as higher profits were offset by more stock outstanding.

"Enron achieved its earnings and operational goals in 1996, the first year of our Enron 2000 initiative to reach net income in excess of $1 billion and achieve a minimum double digit growth in annual earnings per share," said chief executive Kenneth L. Lay.

"In addition, we are pleased that the approval process on our proposed merger with Portland General Corp is moving at a pace that addresses the needs of both the regulatory agencies and our companies."
He noted both companies' shareholders have voted in favor of the merger and late last week the Oregon Public Utility Commission staff recommended it be approved.

"While there are conditions attached to this approval, we look forward to working through this process in meetings with the staff beginning tomorrow. We expect to receive all necessary state and federal approvals by mid-year," Lay said.
